**Finding: compliant** (§18, paragraphs p0228–p0231) — no redline proposed.

Summary of the analysis:

- **No auto-renewal mechanic exists.** Searches for "renew", "automatically", and "prior notice" surface only §18. There is no rolling renewal term, no "unless either party gives notice … days prior" construct, and no renewal price-uplift language.
- **Exit is unilateral and unconditional.** Under §18.1 we may terminate our participation at the end of the 25-year Initial Period *or at any time thereafter*. We are never rolled into a locked further multi-year term, so the walk-away trigger (automatic multi-year renewals) is not engaged.
- **Pricing concern doesn't arise.** Continuing charges are cost-shared O&M allocated under §§6–7, not a vendor-set renewal price, so the CPI/3%/5% uplift caps have no target.
- **Noted, not flagged:** the one (1) year exit notice is longer than the playbook's 30/60-day windows. We treat this as a sub-element note rather than a deviation because it is mutual and symmetrical (it equally guarantees us twelve months' warning of another Party's withdrawal), it reflects the operational reality of a jointly owned submarine cable system, and §18.4 further protects a withdrawing Terminal Party by requiring the remaining Parties to negotiate continued operation of its Terminal Station. Shortening it would be disproportionate to the consortium bargain and would cut against our own interests as a remaining Party.
